title: MindClipPlan
description: One clip as an editor plans it: an ordered list of parts taken from anywhere in one recording, each with the role it plays, the ranges cut out of it, and the joins between them (decision R76). A continuous span is a plan of one part. The plan is a proposal: code checks every time, join and form rule before it becomes an edit document, and a critic checks that no join changes what was meant. Times are integer ticks at 1/90000 s of the source.

plan_id.description: Derived from the plan's content, so the same plan always has the same id.

form.description: The shape of the edit. `straight`: one part, nothing removed. `tightened`: one moment with ranges cut out of it, parts in source order. `stitch`: parts from distant places joined by evidence. `cold_open`: a line lifted from later opens the clip. `theme_montage`: several short moments on one topic or feeling.

hook_text.description: The opening line or on-screen text the plan is built around, as spoken or written; never invented speech.

joins.description: One per pair of consecutive parts, in programme order.

duration_ticks.description: Programme length: the parts' lengths less what was removed from them.

evidence.description: What justifies the plan: Recording Memory event and link ids, unit ids.

doubts.description: What the planner is unsure of, in plain words, shown with the clip.

units.description: The Timeline Index units (sentences or shots) the part covers.

removed.description: Ranges inside this part that the clip leaves out, so a person can see and restore each one.

kind.description: `adjacent`: the next part continues in the source. `reorder`: the order differs from the source, as in a cold open. `distant`: the next part comes from elsewhere in the recording, which needs a link.

link.description: The Recording Memory link that justifies a distant join, such as `question_answer:s0102>s0981`.

crossfade_ms.description: A short audio blend that hides a click or breath at the join.

framing.description: Change of framing at the join, which makes a jump cut on one camera look intended.

room_tone.description: Fill a gap at the join with the recording's own background sound.
